title: Resolve the two DOC admission residues exposed by change 0640 and expose stylesheet leniency through the facade
code_state: PapBinTable trims one proven PAPX word-alignment byte only under OpenOptions::with_papx_alignment_padding(); FBKF.ibkl uniqueness remains strict; litchi::Document adds bounded path and byte entry points carrying litchi_doc::OpenOptions; strict defaults, CFB paths, parser limits and writer encoding remain unchanged
reason_codes: MS-DOC FBKF explicitly requires ibkl to be unique within a Plcfbkf/Plcfbkfd, so watermark.doc remains a typed refusal even though its duplicate and unused PlcfBkl slots carry the same CP

PapxInFkp's cb=0 form stores an even 2*cb' byte container; the POI witness repeats an odd SPRM prefix followed by one zero byte in all 24 PAPX entries, while the checked-in MS-DOC GrpPrlAndIstd rule requires whole Prl elements

the opt-in PAPX admission strips one byte only after strict SPRM parsing identifies an exact one-byte trailing opcode error; parse_sprms remains strict and malformed nonzero or incomplete operands remain errors
the existing OpenOptions/Leniency contract and the new explicit PAPX compatibility profile are reachable through litchi::Document without changing default strict behavior

accepted_evidence.specification: Checked-in 3rdparty/specs/[MS-DOC]/2 Structures/2.9 Basic Types.md §§2.9.70 (FBKF, local lines 6562/6648), 2.9.114 (GrpPrlAndIstd, local lines 12380/12469-12471), and 2.9.175 (PapxInFkp, local lines 18595/18684-18688); 2 Structures/2.8 PLCs.md §2.8.10 (Plcfbkf, local lines 887-893); and 3 Structure Examples/3.5 Example of a PlcBtePapx.md papxinfkp[1] (local lines 162-181), with the corresponding Microsoft Learn pages linked by the change record
accepted_evidence.witnesses: direct unified-facade tests over watermark.doc, strict and opt-in poi/test-data/document/test.doc, and duplicate-style-names.doc
accepted_evidence.unit_tests: PapBinTable alignment and malformed-tail tests plus the global SPRM trailing-zero refusal test and strict-default/explicit-profile facade gate
accepted_evidence.corpus: the 57-file inventory and 0640 retained corpus scan; no new full differential claimed
accepted_evidence.facade: both bounded path and owned-byte leniency routes produce the same text on duplicate-style-names.doc

accepted_costs.FBKF: the duplicate-bookmark fixture remains unavailable under strict reading, as required by the normative uniqueness rule
accepted_costs.PAPX: the checked-in primary text defines the length forms and whole-Prl requirement but does not name a PapxInFkp alignment byte; acceptance is limited to repeated witness evidence and compatible implementation behavior behind explicit OpenOptions::with_papx_alignment_padding(), while strict defaults retain the typed refusal
accepted_costs.facade: the opt-in path eagerly reads a source into the existing bounded fallback before smart detection, while ordinary open behavior is unchanged

known_gaps.PAPX_specification: MS-DOC §2.9.175 defines the PapxInFkp length forms and §2.9.114 requires whole Prl elements, but neither explicitly specifies the observed final alignment byte; §2.9.337's zero padding rule is for UpxPapx/UpxChpx/UpxTapx and does not settle PapxInFkp
known_gaps.corpus_differential: the complete 0640 57-fixture differential was not rerun for this follow-up; the two residues and facade are covered directly
